Subject: Lanmore Realty Holdings - Referral Required

Hi Dana,

Thanks for the submission on Lanmore Realty Holdings.

I've reviewed the account and need to refer this to our senior underwriting team for consideration due to a couple of factors:

- One of the locations falls within our coastal exposure zone (within 16 km of the coast)
- We're monitoring our coastal accumulation carefully, and our existing portfolio concentration within 25 km of the coast is already elevated

I'll present this to the team and circle back with you shortly. Given our current coastal appetite constraints, you may also want to consider reaching out to a specialty coastal property market in parallel to keep things moving for your client.

I'll be in touch soon.

Best regards,
[Underwriter name]
